gen-gf-goldman-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra reads as a plain sans with a prominent x-height, friendly and easy on the eye. And Goldman does the shouting, wide-set and round like open parentheses, while the body simply keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-rambla: Rambla keeps its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals, which gives the text a tidy, compact look. Yet Goldman above it spreads out wide, with generous clearance, so the sans below feels tucked in by comparison.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-recursive: Recursive draws its sans letters with a constant stroke and a tall mean line, modern and approachable. Make Goldman small and its wide display shapes lose their punch.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-roboto-condensed: Contemporary in feel, Roboto Condensed packs its words tight, a line gliding along like wire under the eye. But Goldman sprawls wide and round above it, so the two feel like a shout followed by a brisk murmur.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed reads as modern and unhurried, its text looking magnified without any change in size. Saira Semi Condensed can be scaled up or down freely, since its rod-stock strokes stay put either way.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-secular-one: Goldman is bold and commanding, wide-set with round forms like open parentheses. Secular One follows with a dominant midsection and heavy, unmodulated outlines, so a long passage reads dense, solid and steady.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-smooch-sans: Modern and clean, Smooch Sans sits on a high midline with a packed line where gaps nearly vanish. And Goldman, with its wide stance and round shapes, gives that compact plain sans a roomy, confident headline to lean on.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed brings a big x-height and open, pen-lifted curves with a friendly, approachable manner. Sofia Sans Condensed holds a flat, unshaded stroke across a long stretch, so paragraphs feel smooth and unfussy.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-spline-sans-mono: Technical and exact, Spline Sans Mono sets fixed-width letters with lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Yet Goldman's wide, parenthesis-round forms loosen things up, so a long monospace passage feels like steady code, lined up in tidy columns.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-tiny5: Goldman opens wide and commanding, its round forms spaced with generous clearance and a big lowercase. Tiny5 sits beneath it, clean and tall.
